sum: Terrestrial Energy Inc. engages in the development of small modular nuclear plants using its generation IV integral molten salt reactor (IMSR). The IMSR captures the transformative operating benefits of molten salt reactor technology in a plant design of nuclear energy supply. The company uses a plant design together with molten salt reactor technology and uranium in its fuel for a nuclear plant. Terrestrial Energy Inc. was founded in 2013 and is headquartered in Charlotte, North Carolina.
